title: Maximum Profit with Unlimited Stock Holdings
statement_html:
You are given an integer array prices, where prices[i] is the price of a stock on day i.

On each day you may do exactly one of the following: buy one share, sell one share you own, or do nothing. You may hold any number of shares at the same time, and you start with none.

Return the maximum total profit you can earn.

Example 1:

Input: prices = [10,5,4,7,9,12,6,2,10]
Output: 20
Explanation: Buy at 5 and 4, sell at 9 and 12, then buy at 2 and sell at 10.
Profit = (9 + 12 - 5 - 4) + (10 - 2) = 20.

Example 2:

Input: prices = [1,2,3,4]
Output: 4
Explanation: Buy on days 0 and 1, sell on days 2 and 3: (3 + 4) - (1 + 2) = 4.

Example 3:

Input: prices = [5,4,3]
Output: 0
Explanation: Prices only fall, so it is best not to trade.

Constraints:

  • 1 <= prices.length <= 105

  • 1 <= prices[i] <= 106

Similar to LeetCode #122. Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II (differs in: you may hold many shares at once, but trade at most one share per day).
